# Front and rear differential fluid change

> **[Unverified]** This page rests on a single community report. Cross-check before relying on it.

> **Some safety-critical values on this page are not confirmed** (marked [Unverified] or [Partial]): they come from one source or are only partly supported. Verify against the factory service manual before use; later runs re-check them against new sources.

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

[Partial] Raise the vehicle, shift neutral, and drain old fluid from both front and rear differentials before refilling with gear oil. [t1077]

## Tools

- [Partial] Drain plugs [t1077]

## Specifications

- **Gear Oil Viscosity**: 80W-90 or 75W-90 [t1077] ([Unverified] single report)

## Tips & gotchas

- [Partial] Check if you have a limited slip differential; add friction modifier if unsure. [t1077]
- Look for a metal tag on the back of the rear diff to confirm LSD status. [t1077]
- If uncertain about fluid type, 75W-90 is considered standard. [t1077]

## Common mistakes

- [Partial] Forgetting that the front fill plug location makes gravity filling difficult without assistance. [t1077]
